The Revolution of Fashion Shopping: Virtual Try-On Thanks to AI

20 December 2023 · Virtual Marketer Team

In recent years, buying clothes has increasingly shifted into the digital realm. More and more people are buying their clothing online, whether out of convenience, lack of time, or a wider selection. But the fashion sector in particular comes with certain challenges. One of them is the question of how to ensure that the clothing purchased actually fits and is liked.

This is where virtual try-ons powered by AI come into play. Artificial intelligence is already being used in many areas of fashion shopping to support customers with online shopping. For example, there are already algorithms that can calculate, based on the customer's measurements and the size chart of the respective brand, which size fits best. This technology is helpful, but it has its limits.

Virtual try-on powered by AI, however, goes a step further. With the help of computer vision technology, customers can see the clothing items they want on their own digital likeness. All they need is a photo of themselves, and the software then uses algorithms to virtually place the clothing onto the body. The result is a realistic image of how the garment looks on them.

The advantages of this technology are obvious. Customers can virtually try on clothing before buying it, to make sure it fits and that they like it. This not only saves time and money, but also reduces the need for returns. This allows both customers and companies to save costs.

Furthermore, with virtual try-ons, customers can also experiment with different styles and combinations without actually having to buy and return items of clothing. This can help customers discover new looks and improve their styling.

Virtual try-ons powered by AI offer benefits not only for customers, but also for businesses. By reducing returns and the associated costs, companies can improve their efficiency and increase their profits. In addition, they can use the data collected during the use of the virtual try-on to personalize and improve their customers' shopping experience.

Of course, there are also challenges in implementing AI-powered virtual try-ons. The accuracy of the algorithms is an important factor, since the clothing must be realistically mapped onto the customer's body. In addition, privacy concerns must be taken into account, since customers have to upload their personal photos. It is important that companies respect their customers' privacy and ensure that the data is kept secure.

Overall, AI-powered virtual try-on is a promising technology that can revolutionize fashion shopping online. It offers numerous benefits for both customers and businesses and has the potential to make the online shopping experience even more enjoyable and efficient. It will be exciting to see how this technology develops in the coming years and how it influences fashion shopping online.
